_notes: mode=blacklist exports everything except blacklist entries.
mode=whitelist exports only whitelist entries. Use this for places the players have visited.
Entries can be Public/World wiki paths, generated HTML paths, page names, tags, regions, or locations.
Blacklisted pages always lose, and hidden map markers route to Unknown.md.

worldMap.hiddenMarkerDescription: You have not visited or learned about this place yet.
